prompt:
You are a hardware-debug reviewer. A first debug agent diagnosed an RISC-V RTL failure and an explain.png diagram was drawn from that diagnosis (explain.png sha256 first 16 hex: a577479be4ef24cf).
Case: fetch-highword
Failing trace window (same window the first diagnosis saw):
- tb_picorv32_fetch seed 43
- 256-word NOP mem, checking fetch alignment + trap + progress
tohost: FAIL 0xdead
TRAP: no progress max_addr=0x00000000
CYCLES=2009
- /home/tuncay/afterglow/sim/tb/picorv32-fetch_tb.sv:91: Verilog $finish
- S i m u l a t i o n   R e p o r t: Verilator 5.052 2026-09-05
- Verilator: $finish at 20us; walltime 0.001 s; speed 39.730 ms/s
- Verilator: cpu 0.001 s on 1 threads; allocated 4 MB
First diagnosis (verbatim):
Fetch makes no progress with max_addr stuck at 0x00000000 leading to TRAP: no progress and FAIL 0xdead instead of advancing fetches. In state 0 mem_valid is driven to 0 when mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word==0 so no memory transfer is ever started, versus expected 1. Root cause is picorv32.v:584 missing negation `mem_valid <= mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word` which directly contradicts the invariant at picorv32.v:598 `mem_valid == !mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word`.
First patch_diff:
diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -581,8 +581,8 @@
 			case (mem_state)
 				0: begin
 					if (mem_do_prefetch || mem_do_rinst || mem_do_rdata) begin
-						mem_valid <= mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word;
+						mem_valid <= !mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word;
 						mem_instr <= mem_do_prefetch || mem_do_rinst;
 						mem_wstrb <= 0;
 						mem_state <= 1;
Look at the diagram (explain.png in the run bundle) together with the trace above. Either CONFIRM the first diagnosis (it explains the failing signal and the diff fixes it) or REVISE it (it misnames the signal or the diff is wrong). Reply JSON ONLY with keys: decision (exactly "CONFIRM" or "REVISE"), diagnosis (final diagnosis text), patch_diff (final unified diff), reason (one sentence: why the diagram confirms or what it corrects).
